infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VaultKe uses the camera for video meetings and to take photos for your profile and chat.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VaultKe uses the microphone for audio and video meetings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: VaultKe needs access to your photos so you can set a profile picture and share images in chat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: VaultKe saves images you download from chats to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VaultKe uses your location to tag and find nearby physical chama meetings.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: VaultKe sends you alerts for loan approvals, guarantor requests, contributions and meetings.
